Existing legal doctrine already encompasses this.

There's no reason for legislatures to make new rules concerning "hate speech" when the existing ones will do just fine, if properly applied. Now if the existing rules, when actually applied, are of no use in preventing some new evil, then yes, new rules can and should be thought up, but this is not the case here.
